text:
Just an FYI for anyone in a similar position, and some praise for the #Haifa office!

March, (during the war) submitted #extension application online, but then received the #autoextension before an appointment was scheduled.

May, I emailed Haifa branch to inquire what to do next, and the next morning, I received an email with an appointment date. Very happy with the swift response and instructions what else to bring.

Good luck out there everyone, and שבוע טוב.
